facts.anchor: Elise spends the rest of Sunday pretty much exclusively in bed.
facts.fact: 整个周日余下的时间，Elise 几乎一直待在床上，不读书，也不出门。

facts.anchor: I can’t make it to class today. Can you tell the teachers?
facts.fact: 周一早上，Elise 给 Nafkoté 发短信，说自己今天去不了课堂，请她转告老师。

facts.anchor: Then Elise calls the number on the card the doctor had given her.
facts.fact: 随后 Elise 拨打医生给她的卡片上的号码；前台说提供译员没问题，周六急诊医生已交代过要优先接诊，她当天就能过去。

facts.anchor: she has stage four endometriosis and it has damaged her womb
facts.fact: 译员转告：她患有 stage four endometriosis，子宫已因此受损。

facts.anchor: Conception was eleven weeks ago, and so Elise has one week to terminate the pregnancy
facts.fact: 译员转告：受孕在 eleven weeks ago，所以 Elise 若要终止妊娠，只有一周时间；该期限七年前、2002 年才从十周改为十二周。

facts.anchor: She can do it today, probably, if she wants to. No need to wait.
facts.fact: 译员说，如果她愿意，今天大概就能做清除胎细胞的手术，不必等，因为时间不多。

facts.anchor: She goes to the grocery store on rue Henri-Chevreau and buys all the food
facts.fact: 她走到 rue Henri-Chevreau 的食品店，把想吃的都买了，才意识到自己太久没吃东西。

facts.anchor: Hi, she wrote. Let’s have dinner soon. Friday? Will you still be here then?
facts.fact: 最后她给母亲发短信，开头是 Hi，约她近期吃晚饭、问周五行不行、问她那时是否还在这里，随后关机试着睡觉。
